rows.role_title: 内閣総理大臣 — Prime Minister of Japan
rows.text: Kantei's account dated 25 September 2007 says the Abe cabinet resigned en masse that day: the cabinet meeting collected the ministers' resignations and decided the resignation, the Prime Minister's statement was issued, and 安倍総理 left the Prime Minister's Office.
